Linkage requirements are therefore not met for the candidate beyond co-occurrence.

summary: The evaluator confirmed that the required PDF was absent from the destination. The reviewed stale reuse remained merely concurrent and caused no visible harm, while two frozen competing defects independently explain the failed task, so the chain is classified as co-occurrence only.
